example:
import { EditorialArticle, EditorialArticleSection, EditorialNote, Eyebrow } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialArticle eyebrow={<Eyebrow>PRICE GUIDE</Eyebrow>} title="A fair comparison starts with the details." intro="A matching card name is only the beginning.">
  <EditorialArticleSection title="Check it is the same card" paragraphs={["Confirm the game, card number and set."]} />
  <EditorialNote>An original guide, not a price forecast.</EditorialNote>
</EditorialArticle>
name: EditorialArticle
tagline: The reading column of a long-form editorial page (gh#1440): the ruled kicker, the page's one h1, an intro set off by a rule, then `EditorialArticleSection`s (an h2 and paragraphs at the reading leading), an `EditorialNote` and a trailing `EditorialTextLink`. Block flow with collapsing margins, so the design's rhythm holds. Geometry: `--editorial-article-*`, `--editorial-note-*`.
usage: DO put it in an EditorialSection after an EditorialBreadcrumb on a `flow="sections"` page.

DO pass each prose paragraph in `EditorialArticleSection paragraphs`, not raw `

`.
DON'T use it for a versioned legal/admin document — that is LegalDocumentShell.
